comment: Manually reviewed migrations that intentionally contain destructive SQL. Empty by default for PR-825 expand-only migrations.

reviews.1810140000000_family_acquisition_attribu: ON DELETE CASCADE on family_id FK only — attribution rows must disappear with GDPR family deletion. No DROP/TRUNCATE in up().
reviews.1810140000001_family_growth_feedback.js: ON DELETE CASCADE on family_id FK only — feedback rows must disappear with GDPR family deletion. No DROP/TRUNCATE in up().
reviews.1810160000000_family_feature_override.js: ON DELETE CASCADE on family_id FK only — override rows must disappear with GDPR family deletion. No DROP/TRUNCATE in up(). Schema-only snapshot contract.
reviews.1810230000000_refresh_token_orphan_trust: DELETE refresh_token rows for child sessions tied to revoked/missing trusted_device_id only — fail-safe R4 lineage cleanup; no parent tokens; no child rows with NULL trusted_device_id.
reviews.1810300000000_family_system_help_state.j: ON DELETE CASCADE on family_id FK only — system help state rows must disappear with GDPR family deletion. down() drops table + flag row only. No DROP/TRUNCATE in up().
reviews.1810400000000_payments_v1_entitlements.j: ON DELETE CASCADE on family_id FK for family_entitlements; payment_audit_log uses ON DELETE SET NULL for family/admin refs. Grandfather backfill INSERT only. down() drops new tables + config keys — reviewed PAYMENTS V1 Phase A.
reviews.1810410000000_payments_v1_gift_cards.js: ON DELETE CASCADE on gift_orders→gift_cards; SET NULL on family redemption refs. Schema-only gift tables + indexes in up(). down() drops gift tables — reviewed PAYMENTS V1 Phase D.
reviews.1810420000000_family_growth_intervention: ON DELETE CASCADE on family_id FK only — intervention log rows must disappear with GDPR family deletion. down() drops table only. No DROP/TRUNCATE in up().
reviews.1810420000001_family_growth_intervention: Expands intervention delivery state: ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS, DROP+recreate status CHECK and partial unique index to allow pending claims. down() reverses schema only. No data loss in up().
reviews.1810430000000_schedule_apply_operation.j: ON DELETE CASCADE on child_id and family_id FKs only — schedule-apply idempotency ledger rows must disappear with the child/family they belong to (GDPR deletion), never orphan. Schema-only CREATE TABLE + indexes in up(). No DROP/TRUNCATE in up(); down() drops the table only.
reviews.1810440000000_schedule_period.js: ON DELETE CASCADE on child_id/family_id FKs (GDPR deletion parity with every other child/family-scoped table) and on schedule_period_item.period_id (item rows belong entirely to their period, deleted with it); ON DELETE SET NULL on schedule_period_item.activity_template_id (deleting a content activity_template must not delete the period's historical item row). Schema-only CREATE TABLE + indexes in up() — special_day_schedule is never touched by this migration (revised design keeps periods and explicit Special Days in separate tables). No DROP/TRUNCATE/DELETE in up(); down() drops the two new tables only.
